2026-10-16

results.body_markdown:
**Architecture review: adopt client-side idempotent retries (dedupe key) for payment requests; server dedupe table rejected**

**Highlights**
- Decision locked in on Option A: clients send a dedupe key with every payment request; gateway rejects duplicates for 24 h
- Gateway already supports the idempotency-key header, so no gateway-side changes are required
- Server-side dedupe table explicitly ruled out, avoiding false-positive blocks on legitimate same-amount payments
- Rollout sequenced: web client first, mobile client in the release after next

**Risks**
- All four clients must be updated to send the key; mobile client ships on a two-week cadence, extending the window in which duplicate charges can still occur
- Support team will continue to see duplicate-charge tickets until the mobile release lands

**Next steps**
- Jun to write the ADR documenting the idempotent-retry decision by Wednesday
- Mira to own and publish the rollout plan (web → mobile)
- Theo to update the reconciliation job to read the dedupe key
- Speaker to draft the stakeholder update notifying the support team that duplicate charges will stop after the mobile release
